title: Reviewer verdict
description: Written by a reviewer, read by `wf ingest`. `blocking` is derived: true when any finding is critical or important.

node.description: The node reviewed, e.g. T3.task-review, final-review or delta-review.

task.description: Task id such as T3; null for final and delta reviews.

sha.description: The PR head the review was made against.

result.description: pass: no critical or important findings. findings: at least one finding.
